name: font-maker
description: Explore, preview, and build fonts from SVG glyphs with FontForge, the GPL-3.0-or-later editor created by George Williams and maintained by its contributors.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, design, and build fonts with an agent.
interface.longDescription: A stateful local workshop for importing SVG glyphs, refining metrics, spacing, kerning and ligatures, rendering previews, and exporting validated fonts.
defaultPrompt: Create a font project and its SVG glyph template.
Validate, preview, and export my current font.
